# waroom_incident_description_template (Resource)

Manages the incident description template of the Waroom organization. The template provides the initial description of new incidents.

~> **Note:** An organization has exactly one incident description template, so declare this resource at most once. Creating this resource overwrites any template already set, and destroying it clears the template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The organization has only one incident description template.
resource "waroom_incident_description_template" "example" {
  blob = <<-EOT
    ## Impact

    ## Current status

    ## Next update
  EOT
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `blob` (String) The content of the incident description template. Must not be empty; destroy the resource to clear the template.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource ID. Always `default`, since the organization has only one template.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The organization has only one incident description template, so the import ID is always "default"
terraform import waroom_incident_description_template.example default
```
